# Differential equations

[Eigenfunction theory](eigenfunctions.qmd) develops ODEs, boundary conditions,
self-adjoint Sturm-Liouville problems, separation, and Green's functions.
[PDE foundations](foundations.qmd) then defines problem types, energy estimates,
weak solutions, characteristics, and dimensionless scales.
[Spectral numerical methods](spectral-methods.qmd) combine those ideas with
Fourier and spherical harmonic representations, Gaussian quadrature, and
separate spatial and temporal error checks.
